verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase is Firebase's own documented capability for code that runs automatically in the background, triggered by background events, Auth and Storage triggers, HTTPS requests, or Cloud Scheduler jobs. It deploys with one command and scales automatically. However, these automations are hand-written backend code: nothing in the evidence shows an AI-native or agentic way to define autonomous automations, and Gemini in Firebase and the MCP server are documented only for interactive chat, editor assistance, project management and data work. missing for 10: AI/agent-driven automation setup (natural-language or agent-defined background jobs), autonomous agent runs without user-written code, independent corroboration of scheduled/background automation use.
